claims.allowed_wording: An explicit CM is a dense truth-layout representation over a declared row/column variable split.
claims.plain_wording: A CM lays a Boolean function's truth values out as a matrix.
claims.technical_wording: The public dense output arranges assignments over row variables R and column variables C, with fixed values applied at evaluation.

claims.allowed_wording: Live support and ambient variables are distinct: live variables affect the function, while ambient variables may still define the displayed assignment universe.
claims.plain_wording: A function can depend on fewer variables than the table around it.
claims.technical_wording: Materialization tracks live variables after fixed bindings; an ambient layout may include axes absent from node.vars.

claims.allowed_wording: CM-IR is a canonicalized, interned shared DAG intermediate representation.
claims.plain_wording: CM-IR stores reusable computation structure, not a dense matrix.
claims.technical_wording: compile_expr_to_cm_ir builds canonical CMNode structures with interning, simplification, sharing-aware associative flattening, and optional persistent caching.

claims.allowed_wording: An explicit dense CM and CM-IR are different artifacts with different construction, storage, and evaluation boundaries.
claims.plain_wording: The matrix is an output layout; CM-IR is a reusable program graph.
claims.technical_wording: materialize_cm produces a dense array, whereas evaluate_compiled/materialize_hybrid_no_reinflate can return packed or flat truth output without dense CM reinflation.

claims.allowed_wording: Common subexpression elimination computes repeated expression subtrees once and reuses them.
claims.plain_wording: CSE shares repeated work.
claims.technical_wording: Plain structural CSE interns repeated subtrees but may retain binary associative chains.

claims.allowed_wording: Sharing-aware CSE-flat additionally flattens eligible associative chains while preserving shared nodes.
claims.plain_wording: CSE-flat shares repeats and safely widens associative chains.
claims.technical_wording: The primary comparator is sharing-aware structural CSE with flatten=True; it is stronger than the raw-AST ablation and plain unflattened CSE.

claims.allowed_wording: CM-IR can add canonical normalization and merging beyond the transformations shared with CSE-flat.
claims.plain_wording: CM-IR and CSE-flat overlap, but CM-IR may normalize more structure.
claims.technical_wording: Any observed difference must be attributed to the actual instruction/operation reductions on the scoped workload, not to the CM label alone.

claims.allowed_wording: On the exactly counterbalanced B2/B4 V3 workload, formula-balanced bare CM/CSE-flat was 0.8906 with a formula-cluster 95% interval [0.8741, 0.9073].
claims.plain_wording: Compiled bare CM was modestly faster than CSE-flat on this one corrected workload.
claims.technical_wording: CM/CSE-flat=0.8905696773, paired formula-cluster percentile-bootstrap 95% CI [0.8740654100,0.9072717742], 216 formula clusters and 264 rows.
claims.scope: B2/B4 V3 formulas on one Windows run
claims.uncertainty: formula-cluster bootstrap; does not model between-run or between-machine variation

claims.allowed_wording: The B2/B4 V3 bare CM/CSE-flat advantage narrowed toward k=16: formula-balanced ratio 0.9612 [0.9290, 0.9942].
claims.plain_wording: The measured gap got smaller at support 16.
claims.technical_wording: At live_k=16, CM/CSE-flat=0.9612336537 with formula-cluster 95% CI [0.9289740604,0.9941768792].

claims.allowed_wording: Across three guarded CPU pods, row-weighted bare CM/CSE-flat was 0.9026–0.9126 overall and 0.9746–0.9766 at k=16.
claims.plain_wording: Three Linux CPU replications put the overall ratio near 0.909, with a much smaller k=16 gap.
claims.technical_wording: Immutable pod raw CSVs reproduce overall geomeans 0.9026, 0.9118, and 0.9126; k=16 0.9766, 0.9746, and 0.9752.
claims.uncertainty: descriptive across three machines; post-hoc per-pod formula intervals are separate

claims.allowed_wording: The public CM wrapper was slower than CSE-flat in the corrected comparison.
claims.plain_wording: The easy public call did not produce an end-to-end speedup.
claims.technical_wording: Formula-balanced local wrapper/CSE-flat was 3.0941 [2.8831,3.3108]; the earlier corrected three-pod row-weighted ratios were approximately 2.78–2.81 overall.
claims.ratio_direction: CM wrapper/CSE-flat; above one disfavors CM
claims.uncertainty: local formula-cluster interval plus descriptive pod replication

claims.allowed_wording: On the accepted EPFL AND/INV workload, CM/CSE-flat was 0.9998 with a circuit-clustered 95% interval [0.9747, 1.0249].
claims.plain_wording: On this circuit workload, the two compiled kernels were at parity.
claims.technical_wording: Blocked CM/CSE-flat geomean=0.9998256739, circuit-clustered bootstrap CI [0.9746915270,1.0249051889], n=129.
claims.scope: EPFL AND/INV cones, semantic support 8–16, one Windows machine

claims.allowed_wording: On the EPFL AND/INV workload, CM and CSE-flat had equal instruction and executed-operation counts, matching the parity mechanism prediction.
claims.plain_wording: There was no extra mergeable chain left for CM on this workload.
claims.technical_wording: Instruction and executed-operation ratios were both exactly 1.000; flattening already captured the available associative reduction.
claims.uncertainty: exact count equality on accepted corpus

claims.allowed_wording: EPFL CM preparation was 4.11x CSE-flat preparation; 55 of 129 cases never broke even under the retained calculation.
claims.plain_wording: One-time CM preparation can erase a kernel gain unless the artifact is reused enough.
claims.technical_wording: Preparation multiple geomean 4.11; finite break-even median 174.5 over 74 cases, with 55/129 never reaching break-even.
claims.ratio_direction: CM prep/CSE-flat prep; above one disfavors CM

claims.allowed_wording: Current evidence does not support a universal claim that CM beats CSE-flat.
claims.plain_wording: The winner depends on workload and measurement boundary.
claims.technical_wording: B2/B4 V3 shows a scoped bare-kernel reduction; EPFL shows parity; the public wrapper remains slower.

claims.allowed_wording: Every ratio must state numerator, denominator, workload, measurement boundary, and uncertainty; below one favors CM only for CM/comparator.
claims.plain_wording: A ratio has no honest direction without its labels.
claims.technical_wording: No chart may infer direction from position or color alone.

claims.allowed_wording: The corrected focused k=13–15 study did not justify a universal width-only selector change.
claims.plain_wording: Width alone did not choose the best engine reliably.
claims.technical_wording: The predeclared gate failed on reused validation because one CM row reached catastrophic regret; no selector change was made.
claims.uncertainty: reused validation is not untouched held-out evidence

claims.allowed_wording: Eager, lazy, pair-aware, hybrid, partial-hybrid, parallel, and packed/word paths must be described only within their implemented and tested contracts.
claims.plain_wording: The project has several execution paths, but their names do not imply one winner.
claims.technical_wording: Current documentation and code distinguish dense wrappers, delayed materialization, pair-aware collapse, hybrid dispatch, partial-hybrid structure preservation, parallel materialization, and packed evaluators.

claims.allowed_wording: The CRSE recognition program is experimental; no learned model is promoted.
claims.plain_wording: The learning work has useful engineering results and retained failures, but no production model.
claims.technical_wording: The register separates measured slices, exact controls, negative transfer, held or failed criteria, and no-promotion decisions.

claims.allowed_wording: Milestone C2's learned representation and size-transfer criteria failed while the exact CM detector remained perfect.
claims.plain_wording: The learned decomposition detector did not transfer, even though the exact control worked.
claims.technical_wording: Independent verification recomputed retained tables and model decisions without error; learned criteria failed and no model was promoted.

claims.allowed_wording: Natural decomposition, direct-cut, and variable-conditioned learned arms improved some slices but failed the required held-out transfer/promotion criteria.
claims.plain_wording: Better scores on some circuits did not become reliable held-out cuts.
claims.technical_wording: C3–C5 retain exact verification, weak accepted-positive recall, held-out square failures, and learned paths slower than exact ANF.

claims.allowed_wording: Milestone C6's packed exact source-ANF core advanced, but its gate and production path did not.
claims.plain_wording: A deterministic packed core improved, without promoting the whole system.
claims.technical_wording: Packed/cached cores achieved retained median and p95 gains over truth-vector ANF; the validation-frozen gate missed confirmatory p95 by 1.4%.

claims.allowed_wording: Milestone D task routing helped restrictions and repeated work but slowed complete-vector requests; dense-CM construction and per-instance rewrite proof were negative.
claims.plain_wording: Routing helped some tasks and hurt others.
claims.technical_wording: Construction, routing, proof, kernel, cache, and audit costs were measured separately.

claims.allowed_wording: The frozen one-pass rewrite result changed from 1.050x on Windows to 0.929x on Linux, so unconditional one-pass rewriting was not promoted.
claims.plain_wording: The rewrite looked helpful on one machine and lost on Linux.
claims.technical_wording: Exactness and rule incidence reproduced, but profitability did not transfer; the Linux result is a retained negative control.
claims.ratio_direction: reported as speedup; below one loses

claims.allowed_wording: Milestone D9's frozen policy abstained on all evaluation workloads and preserved exactness, but the charged gate remained slower and no rewrite policy was promoted.
claims.plain_wording: Abstention avoided bad rewrites but still cost time.
claims.technical_wording: Exact factoring reduced operations, unconditional one pass lost, and the all-abstain gate measured 0.982x versus no rewrite.

claims.allowed_wording: Teaching diagrams, proposed mechanisms, and hypotheses must be visibly labeled and may not be presented as measured traces.
